systemArchitectures.name: Commercial Continuous High-Pressure CO2 Explosion Extrusion Skid
systemArchitectures.classification: Industrial Dense-Phase Supercritical Extrusion Skid (ASME Section VIII Div 1 & 2 / CGA G-6 / 3-A Sanitary Standards 04-05 & 23-06 / EHEDG Class I Aseptic)
systemArchitectures.technology: Twin-Screw Co-Rotating Extruder Barrel (L/D 48:1) with High-Pressure Supercritical CO2 Direct Injection (80–180 bar, 35–65°C) and Converging-Diverging Decompression Slit Die
systemArchitectures.metallurgy: Electropolished AISI 316L (Ra ≤ 0.38 µm) with Inconel 625 Barrel Sleeve Liners and CVD Diamond-Coated Nitrided Tool Steel Screws
systemArchitectures.safetyInterlocks: Continuous Ambient CO2 Multi-Point Infrared Detectors (OSHA PEL < 5,000 ppm TWA scram), Dual ASME UV Rupture Discs, and Pneumatic Emergency De-Inventory Purge Valves
systemArchitectures.description: Premier continuous industrial texturization skid for non-thermal structuring of plant proteins into anisotropic, whole-muscle meat analogs. Supercritical CO2 plasticizes plant globulin dough under moderate shear and mild temperature (35–65°C), while sudden supersonic decompression nucleates micro-cellular pores and aligns protein fibril bundles without Maillard scorching, cross-linking lysinoalanine formation, or vitamin destruction.

systemArchitectures.name: Co-Rotating Twin-Screw Supercritical CO2 Micro-Cellular Puffer
systemArchitectures.classification: Continuous Food Extrusion Texturizer (FDA 21 CFR § 117 FSMA cGMP / 3-A Sanitary Standard 23-06)
systemArchitectures.technology: Medium-Format Twin-Screw Modular Extruder (L/D 40:1) with Dual Mid-Barrel scCO2 Metering Injections & Hydrodynamic Shear Mixing Kneaders
systemArchitectures.metallurgy: AISI 316L Food-Contact Surfaces with Hastelloy C-276 High-Pressure Injection Ports and FDA-Grade PTFE/Fluorosilicone Dynamic Shaft Seals
systemArchitectures.safetyInterlocks: Extruder Barrel Overpressure Probes, Fast-Acting Vent Flaps, and Exhaust Blower Interlocks
systemArchitectures.description: High-efficiency commercial texturization system engineered for plant-based poultry, fish fillets, and high-moisture nuggets. Delivers tender fibrillar texture and high water-holding capacity while reducing extruder motor power draw by 40% via CO2 solubilization.

systemArchitectures.name: Dual-Injector Deep-Shear Dense-Phase Extrusion Texturizer
systemArchitectures.classification: Advanced High-Shear Supercritical Biopolymer Texturizer (ASME BPVC Sec VIII Div 2 / USDA Organic Compliant)
systemArchitectures.technology: Triple-Zone Extrusion Engine with Ultra-High Pressure Primary Dissolution Zone (150–220 bar) and Secondary Temperature-Controlled Shaping Die
systemArchitectures.metallurgy: Solid Inconel 718 Extrusion Barrel with Titanium Grade 5 Converging Discharge Slit Orifices
systemArchitectures.safetyInterlocks: Triple-Redundant Electronic Strain Gauges, High-Pressure Gas Auto-Bleeders, and Acoustic Explosion Suppressors
systemArchitectures.description: Precision texturizer designed for premium clean-label beef steak and fibrous tuna analogue texturizing. Achieves hyper-dense fiber orientation and near-zero protein denaturation through ultra-dense CO2 supercritical solubilization at 35°C.

systemArchitectures.name: Cleanroom Modular Pilot HPCD-EE Research & Validation Skid
systemArchitectures.classification: Aseptic Pilot Food Extrusion Simulator (ISO Class 5 Cleanroom / CE-PED 2014/68/EU)
systemArchitectures.technology: Modular Variable-L/D (32:1 to 52:1) Co-Rotating Extruder with Real-Time In-Line Raman Spectroscopy and High-Speed Optical Porosimetry
systemArchitectures.metallurgy: Electropolished AISI 316L with Monolithic Tungsten Carbide Screw Elements and Sapphire Optical Sight Ports
systemArchitectures.safetyInterlocks: Class 1 Div 2 Electrical Certification, Automatic Nitrogen Dilution Purge, and Emergency CO2 Quench
systemArchitectures.description: Validation and formulation skid for pilot plants, food biotechnology laboratories, and alternative protein innovators formulating next-generation cultivated-plant hybrid meat analogs and novel recombinant protein matrices.

proteinMatrices.name: Yellow Pea Protein Isolate (85% Protein, Legumin/Vicilin Ratio 1:2.4)
proteinMatrices.description: Non-GMO yellow pea globulins rich in 11S legumin and 7S vicilin. Supercritical CO2 lowers dough viscosity, allowing dense fibril alignment at 48°C. Decompression forms juicy, springy chicken-breast fiber structures with zero beany off-notes or bitter saponin degradation.

proteinMatrices.name: Soy 11S Glycinin & Fusarium venenatum Mycoprotein Hybrid Matrix
proteinMatrices.description: High-performance hybrid matrix combining soy glycinin disulfide-rich globulins with fungal branching micro-filaments. HPCD-EE aligns natural fungal hyphae and globulins into directional muscle bundles with exceptional tensile chewiness matching flank steak.

proteinMatrices.name: Faba Bean & Kabuli Chickpea Globulin Hydrocolloid Emulsion
proteinMatrices.description: Clean-label faba bean and chickpea protein matrix with balanced amino acid profile. Low-temperature scCO2 texturizing completely bypasses alkaline lysinoalanine (LAL) formation and preserves delicate lysine and cystine residues.

proteinMatrices.name: Upcycled Oat Protein & Brewer's Spent Grain (BSG) Dietary Fiber Matrix
proteinMatrices.description: Upcycled circular economy matrix rich in beta-glucans, arabinoxylans, and avenin globulins. Dense-phase CO2 micro-bubbles shear tough lignocellulose fibers, creating tender, moist shredded beef analogs without astringent polyphenolic scorching.

proteinMatrices.name: Chlorella vulgaris Microalgae & Cold-Pressed Sunflower Kernel Matrix
proteinMatrices.description: Sustainable allergen-free formulation containing high-protein microalgae biomass and helianthinin globulins. Non-thermal CO2 explosion retains chlorophyll pigments and polyunsaturated omega-3 fatty acids without rancid oxidative fishy odours.

injectionNozzles.name: Converging-Diverging Supersonic Decompression Slit Die
injectionNozzles.description: De Laval geometry engineered for supersonic pressure drop rate (dP/dt > 8 x 10^8 Pa/s). Forces supercritical CO2 into immediate thermodynamic instability, nucleating over 10^7 micro-cells per cm³ with zero melt fracture or bubble coalescence.

injectionNozzles.name: Annular Laminar Shear Co-Axial Extrusion Die
injectionNozzles.description: Co-axial annular discharge establishing high laminar shear along the extruder barrel exit. Orients protein molecules into parallel concentric fiber sheets, creating realistic flaky fish fillet and layered crab stick analogues.

injectionNozzles.name: Multi-Slit Ribbed Anisotropic Muscle Fiber Forming Shaper
injectionNozzles.wearResistance: Maximum (Silicon Nitride Si3N4 Ceramic Die Inserts)
injectionNozzles.description: Ultra-fine multi-slit array splitting pressurized dough into distinct microscopic strands before supersonic explosion. Delivers ultra-high anisotropic fiber ratios (R_fib > 3.5) with longitudinal muscle bundle texturization.

injectionNozzles.name: Conventional High-Temperature Thermal Slit Die (Hazardous / Ineffective Control)
injectionNozzles.description: Slow, non-pressurized single-orifice die relying on thermal steam expansion (150°C). Destroys 35–45% of available lysine via Maillard reactions, forms toxic lysinoalanine cross-links, and yields rubbery, unpalatable sponges with uneven cavities.

expansionEnvironments.name: Controlled Low-Pressure Steam Backpressure Receiver (1.5–3.0 bar)
expansionEnvironments.safetyInterlocks: Continuous ASME Section VIII Overpressure Valves & Condensate Level Controls
expansionEnvironments.description: Saturated steam backpressure envelope cushioning the sudden explosive exit. Prevents cell-wall rupture and gas blow-out, locking in micro-cellular honeycomb bubbles and preserving maximum fiber elongation.

expansionEnvironments.name: Nitrogen-Blanketed Inert Partial-Vacuum Receiver (200–500 mbar)
expansionEnvironments.safetyInterlocks: Inert Nitrogen Oxygen Ingress Sensors & Vacuum Pump Protection Filters
expansionEnvironments.description: Oxygen-free sub-atmospheric chamber facilitating rapid expansion cooling and surface setting. Eliminates oxidative lipid degradation and stabilizes delicate heat-sensitive aromas and natural carotenoid pigments.

expansionEnvironments.name: Isobaric Ambient Conditioning Tunnel (1013 mbar, 25°C)
expansionEnvironments.safetyInterlocks: High-Volume Exhaust Hoods & Industrial Acoustic Silencers
expansionEnvironments.description: Direct expansion into an atmospheric conditioning conveyor. Simple operational design suitable for standard texturized vegetable protein chunks; modest cell coalescence compared to pressurized receivers.

expansionEnvironments.name: Unventilated Enclosed Ambient Explosion Zone (Hazardous / Ineffective Control)
expansionEnvironments.safetyInterlocks: None (Severe Workplace Asphyxiation & Violent Shrapnel Hazard)
expansionEnvironments.description: Uncontrolled discharge into unventilated factory floor space. Gaseous CO2 rapidly accumulates above 45,000 ppm (4.5% v/v), creating instant toxic asphyxiation hazards for operators while supersonic dough shocks create uneven ragged tears.
